export_rights.summary: Expensify's GDPR commitment states that 'our product tools allow users to export data, manage preferences, and close accounts anytime.' Closing an account permanently deletes unsubmitted expenses and personal data; expenses submitted on a workspace may be retained for regulatory compliance and remain visible to workspace approvers and admins.

routes.how: Classic web app: Expenses or Reports tab, select rows (filter by date range, workspace, category, tag, submitter, status first), click 'Export to' top-right and pick a template. New Expensify: Spend > Expenses (or Reports), check rows or select all, Selected > Export, pick a template ('Export current view' matches on-screen columns). Built-in templates include All Data - Expense Level, All Data - Report Level, Basic Export, Canadian Multiple Tax, Category, Per Diem, Tag.
requires: web app (Classic mobile app has no export)
Workspace Admin role to see other members' submitted expenses (Outstanding/Approved/Paid only; members' unreported expenses are not visible)
gotchas: In New Expensify, only Basic Export downloads directly; other templates are delivered via Concierge in the Inbox
Export templates are unavailable while 'Group by' filters are active (Basic Export still works and preserves groups)
Custom templates export one line per expense; only 'All Data - Report Level' gives one row per report
Long IDs open in Excel as scientific notation; import CSV with ID columns formatted as Text
Receipt URL columns 404 unless the clicker is logged into an Expensify account in the same browser

routes.how: Integration Server: POST https://integrations.expensify.com/Integration-Server/ExpensifyIntegrations with form-encoded 'requestJobDescription' JSON (credentials = partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret generated at expensify.com/tools/integrations/) plus a 'template' field. Two-step export: job type 'file' with inputSettings.type 'combinedReportData' (filters.reportIDList accepts comma-separated report IDs) and a FreeMarker template returns a random file name; then job type 'download' with that fileName and fileSystem 'integrationServer' returns the file. Job type 'get' with inputSettings.type 'policy' exports policy (workspace) data such as categories and tags; job type 'update' drives the Advanced Employee Updater.
requires: Domain Control + Domain Admin + Policy Admin, verified via concierge@expensify.com, for the Expense Creator API on behalf of other users
routes.rate_limits: Max 5 requests per 10 seconds and 20 requests per 60 seconds; exceeding returns HTTP 429
gotchas: The 'file' job exports expense/report data only, not policy data - use 'get' with inputSettings.type 'policy' for categories/tags
Only onReceive immediateResponse 'returnRandomFileName' is supported; you must capture the random file name to run the download job
Boolean template fields output nothing without a string cast, e.g. ${expense.billable?string("Yes", "No")}
No documented per-user export filter; export all users and filter downstream
Vendor's own Integrations sample repo (creds template, expensify_export.sh, everything_csv.fm) was archived in 2022

routes.how: Custom CSV export formats built from report- and expense-level formulas: personal templates at Settings > Account > Preferences > CSV Export Formats > New Export Format; workspace-wide templates at Settings > Workspaces > [workspace] > Export Formats tab > New Export Format (shareable with other workspace admins). Insights raw data: Settings-side Insights page, click 'View Raw Data' next to a dataset, then 'Export To' > CSV.
requires: Workspace Admin for workspace-level export formats
gotchas: Custom templates export one line per expense, not per report
Workspace export formats are limited to that workspace

routes.how: Per-report PDF includes all expenses, attached receipts, and report notes. Classic: Reports tab > open report > Details (top-right) > download icon. New Expensify: open report > three dots > 'Download as PDF', or Spend > Reports > select multiple/all > Selected > 'Download as PDF' (each report becomes its own PDF; Concierge can deliver the files in chat). CSV exports carry receipt URLs (Basic Export includes a receipt URL column) rather than embedded images.
gotchas: Only the primary receipt image per expense is included in exports and downloadable reports; additional receipt images are visible only inside Expensify
Classic allows only one report PDF download at a time
Large reports with high-resolution receipt images may fail to generate; vendor suggests splitting the report
No per-expense PDF export - PDF is report-level only
Receipt URLs require an authenticated Expensify browser session or they return 404

routes.how: API job type 'get' with inputSettings.type 'policy' exports policy/workspace data such as categories and tags (Policy ID = Workspace ID, visible in the workspace settings URL). Inside the product, 'Duplicate workspace' (Workspaces > three dots > Duplicate workspace) copies Overview, Members, Reports, Accounting Connection, Categories, Tags, Taxes, Workflows, Rules, Merchant rules, Distance Rates, Per Diem, Invoices, and Travel into a new workspace - a restore path within Expensify, not a downloadable artifact.
requires: Workspace Admin to duplicate a workspace
routes.rate_limits: Same Integration Server limits: 5 requests/10s, 20 requests/60s
gotchas: No documented file export of approval workflows or rules; category/tag CSV files are documented for import, with 'Download CSV' offered only for the import template
Duplicate Workspace keeps configuration inside Expensify only - it is not an off-platform backup

preservation_notes.attachments: Report-level PDF export is the documented bulk route for receipt images ('all expenses, attached receipts, and report notes'); New Expensify supports multi-report PDF download. Only the primary receipt image per expense is included; extra receipt images exist only in-app. CSV exports include receipt URLs that require a logged-in session to open.
preservation_notes.audit_log: No account- or workspace-level audit-log export is documented. Per-report changes (including admin and delegate actions) are tracked in the 'Report History and Comments' section at the bottom of each report, viewable in-app; no bulk export or retention period for this history is documented - verify in-tenant whether it appears in the report PDF.
preservation_notes.config_artifacts: Partially covered: the API 'get' job with inputSettings.type 'policy' returns workspace configuration (categories, tags, etc.), and 'Duplicate workspace' clones settings including workflows and rules inside Expensify. No documented export of workflows/rules/custom export formats as standalone restorable files.

notes: help.expensify.com, docs.expensify.com, integrations.expensify.com, and expensify.com were unreachable through this session's egress proxy, so the help articles above were read from their canonical open source in the vendor's Expensify/App GitHub repository (docs/articles/, main branch, retrieved 2026-08-08) - same content, vendor-authored. The full Integration Server manual (integrations.expensify.com/Integration-Server/doc/) could not be fetched, so export-job filters beyond filters.reportIDList (e.g. date-range filters) and any receipt-download API are not documented here. Honest unknowns: no whole-account/tenant backup export is documented; no account-level audit-log export or audit retention period is documented; the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy pages were unreachable, so the export-rights summary rests on the GDPR help article and close-account article, and no post-termination retrieval window is documented anywhere consulted. 'Default Export Templates' article referenced by the Insights doc was not found in the current docs tree (likely renamed); the seven default templates are cited from the Insights article instead.
